motivation: Two observed branch products shared build 508 while version/source differed; legacy installed packages had no source commit metadata. Version/build alone were insufficient to bind acceptance evidence.

runtimeContract.CLI: --version --json: compiled cliVersion plus appPackage metadata or explicit null outside an App
runtimeContract.sourceScope: Containing App packager claim, not binary source attestation; never query Git at runtime or borrow neighboring App/current directory metadata.
runtimeContract.legacy: Absent or malformed source fields remain unknown; numeric version/build and validated commit only.
runtimeContract.reader: Kernel self-executable path, symlink resolution, exact Contents/Helpers layout, nonblocking regular-file read capped at 1 MiB.
runtimeContract.buildScope: Exact Git root only; source commit and Git working-tree state sampled before and after compilation. HEAD/state drift aborts before replacing products. Dirty is not a full source snapshot.

checks: exact current commit, commit count and tracked/staged/untracked dirty state
unpacked subfolder cannot borrow parent repository identity; non-Git source stays unknown
HEAD (including same-count amend), state or version drift refuses packaging and preserves existing outputs
standalone source stays null; plain version unchanged; conflicting formats refused
legacy containing App version is separate from compiled CLI version; no commit guessed
actual Helpers executable and external symlink locate the same containing App
invalid claims not exported; FIFO metadata refused without blocking

initialFailure.observed: Initial VersionReportTests process trapped with signal 5; metadata parser tests passed.
initialFailure.fix: Version report and tests now read ThermoVersion.string rather than the executable-entry global initializer.

visibleUI.stamped: About shows complete 24fc4c7 source SHA and Chinese clean-working-tree label.
visibleUI.legacy: About shows source unknown even though a Git repository is available elsewhere.
visibleUI.dirty: About shows full 93df7ac commit SHA and Chinese dirty-working-tree label.

scriptFollowUp: Capture SCM metadata before reading the marketing version; recheck version even for an already-dirty tree. Commit/state/version drift checked before output replacement.

additionalRealDirtyPackage.context: The untracked evidence JSON, not a claimed source-code change, made Git report dirty. This validates conservative working-tree labeling.
